summary: Tested CRITICAL stock accounting bug fix for SC with_material flow. All 7 new tests + 4 regression tests passed. Backend safeguard correctly blocks RM stock addition during receipt for with_material SC.
passed_tests: CRITICAL: Receipt blocks RM stock addition for with_material SC - FG stock increases, RM stock does NOT increase
without_material SC receipt still adds stock for received items normally
MO auto-completes when all job_work_parts are received
MO completion does NOT add FG stock again (double-count prevention verified)
received_quantity correctly updated on job_work_parts across multiple receipts
Complex BOM scenario: SA→PT1+PT2 - SA stock increases, PT1/PT2 stock does NOT increase during receipt
Regression: DC Send correctly deducts RM/component stock
Regression: SC receipt no double stock E2E (from iteration 35)
Regression: create-sc endpoint returns order details for frontend dialog
critical_code_review_comments: Backend (server.py lines 6086-6090): valid_receipt_item_ids correctly built from job_work_parts for with_material SC
Backend (server.py lines 6109-6113): should_add_stock flag correctly blocks RM items from stock addition
Backend (server.py lines 6217-6218): MO completion block correctly does NOT add FG stock again - comment explains double-count prevention
Fix is well-implemented: For with_material SC, only items in job_work_parts (FG/SA/Parts) get stock added during receipt. Items from SC lines (RM) are blocked.
seed_data_creation: Test items (FG, SA, PT, RM), BOMs, routings, suppliers, production orders, MOs, SC orders, DCs, and receipts created during backend testing with unique UUID suffixes for isolation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRITICAL stock accounting bug fix verified. For with_material SC: (1) DC Send correctly deducts RM from stock, (2) Receipt ONLY adds stock for job_work_parts items (FG/SA), NOT for RM items from SC lines. Backend safeguard uses valid_receipt_item_ids set built from job_work_parts. If receipt accidentally includes RM item_ids, backend blocks stock addition for those items. MO auto-completes when all job_work_parts received, but does NOT add FG stock again (double-count prevention). without_material SC still works normally.

critical_rm_stock_safeguard.details: Receipt endpoint validates items against job_work_parts. RM items from SC lines are blocked from stock addition. Tested with simple FG→RM BOM and complex SA→PT1+PT2 BOM scenarios.

mo_auto_completion.details: MO auto-completes when all job_work_parts are received. Does NOT add FG stock again at completion.

without_material_sc.details: without_material SC receipt still adds stock for received items normally (valid_receipt_item_ids is empty, so all items can receive stock).

dc_send_deduction.details: DC Send correctly deducts RM/component stock from inventory.
